title: 地盤工学
subtitle: Geotechnical Engineering
teachers:
TAKAHARA Toshiyuki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
keywords: Earth pqressure theory of Rankine and Coulomb
limit equilibrium method for slope stability
educationalGoal:
This course is application of Soil  Mechanics I and II,  focuses on Lateral Earth Pressure and Slope Stability. Complete solutions are not exist for earth pressure and slope stability until now, then we have to combine theoretical and empirical method.
Students are expected to choose solution method and soil parameters appropriately, and calculate the stability design.

Coulomb's method
static earth pressure

Earth retaining wall

2.Stability of slope
Limit equilibrium method of slope stability

Jambu's method for non circular slip surface
Natural slope failure and structure
books: Soil Mechanics Edition, by Yasufuku, Riko-Tosho
requiredKnowledge:
Aquisition of Soilmechanics I and II.
Enough skill of Physics (especially Mechanics of elastic body)

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand  applicable condition and calculation method of Rankin and Coulomb's earth pressure.
Be able to calculate stability analysis of earth retaining wall.
Be able to understand basic knowledge of slope stability analysis and slice method.
Be able to understand mechanism of slope failure and estimate stability of slope with appropriate parameters.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Fully understand the behavioral goals of Geotechnical Analysis, and acquire basic skills as an engineer.
(2) be able to carry out basic design for earth retaining wall,
(3) Calculate slope stability under several condition with appropriate parameters.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Understand the behavioral goals of Geotechnical Analysis, Calculate earth pressure to retaining wall as an engineer.
(2) Understand estimation method for slope stability.
